details:
This update for containerd fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-39882: go.opentelemetry.io/otel/exporters/otlp/otlptrace/otlptracehttp: Memory exhaustion via uncapped HTTP
  response body reading (bsc#1274214).
- CVE-2026-47262: Denial of Service (DoS) condition via a maliciously crafted image (bsc#1268441).
- CVE-2026-53488: CRI plugin propagates labels from an image config to a container without validation (bsc#1268430).
- CVE-2026-53493: a crafted OCI index graph can force very high CPU/memory usage during PullImage (before container
  start), causing long ContainerCreating stalls and, at larger sizes, node/runtime instability (bsc#1282669).
- CVE-2026-53495: CRI ExecSync Goroutine Leak Leads to Node-Level Denial of Service (bsc#1280007).
- CVE-2026-95838: github.com/containerd/containerd: processing of certain image layers causes superlinear time
  complexity in unpack handler and can lead to DoS (bsc#1285124).
